'''Spira''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It had beautiful [[Beach/Legends|beaches]] and was a popular resort. It had a low axial tilt, which gave it a large temperate zone over much of its surface.

==History==
Spira was first colonized around [[1000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. It was the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Lytton sector/Legends|Lytton sector]]. A popular tourist destination, it possessed 4,527 luxury [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] some [[30 BBY/Legends|thirty years before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

It lacked any dangerous land fauna and flora on its many islands, and the number of nautical dangers was also low, even though there were some dangerous animals like the [[Galub slug]] and the [[camray eel]]. The relatively safe tropical environment made the planet one of the leading water sports resorts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] within easy reach of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

It was speckled with literally thousands of islands, which in the day of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] were inhabited by rich and famous civilians, but were occupied by members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] elite during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Apart from holidaying [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Governor/Legends|governors]], officers and the like, Imperial presence on the planet was scarce. There was an Imperial garrison there, but they were mostly servants to the holidaying Imperials rather than [[New Order/Legends|imposing]] the will of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].

Spira was governed by the [[Tourist Guild]] under the Imperial control, as part of an agreement with the Empire to allow only passenger ships, supply shuttles and Imperial vessels to enter and exit the system. In accordance with the Empire, there were hardly any non-[[Human/Legends|human]] residents on the planet. Those that were there, were typically employees doing very menial tasks.

During the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]] planned to take a vacation on the planet's beaches, following the resolution of the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Empire Reborn)|Battle of Yavin 4]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].
